"""Reusable grid helpers for ARC-style table/line tasks."""
from collections import Counter, deque

def modal_color(grid):
    """Most common color in the grid."""

    """Column indices containing no background-colored cell."""

    return [[grid[i][j] for j in cols] for i in rows]


def line_color(grid, rows, cols):

    cs = set(cols)

def shrink_rectangles(inter, bg, ignore=()):
    """Shrink each maximal same-value rectangle to its top-left ceil(h/2) x ceil(w/2), others -> bg."""
    H, W = len(inter), len(inter[0])
    lab = [[-1] * W for _ in range(H)]

            for a in range(math.ceil(rh / 2)):
